metaTitle: Nick Perry Digital | Western Slope Websites and Local SEO
metaDescription: Nick Perry builds websites and runs local SEO for businesses on Colorado's Western Slope. Website build $1,000. Monthly plans from $850. No long-term contract.
heroTitle: Websites and local SEO for businesses that want the phone to ring.
heroText: I am Nick Perry. I build search-ready sites, set up your Google Business Profile, and stay on the work after launch. Prices are posted. There is no long-term contract.
introTitle: A Western Slope practice, not a template with a city name swapped in.
introText:
Grand Junction, the valley towns around it, the I-70 corridor, and Durango do not search the same way. I plan the site and the Google listing for the towns you actually serve.

You talk to me. The results page on this site stays empty of fake quotes and fake numbers until a real project can be told in public.
servicesText: Start with a website, a Google listing, or a monthly plan. AI search work is there when you want to be considered by answer engines, not only the map pack.
townsText: Each town has its own page with the posted prices and a short FAQ. The list matches the places I am set up to work, from the Grand Valley to Durango.
guaranteesText: These are the terms I will put in writing. The same list is on the pricing page.
resultsText: I will not invent a client, a quote, or a traffic number to fill this space. The card below is a placeholder layout. A real project replaces it when the client says the story can be told.
praiseText: Client quotes will show up here only with a name and permission. There are none yet.
trustedText: Logos go here after a real engagement. I will not place a mark I do not have permission to use.
pressText: Publication logos go here after a real mention. None are shown yet.
